children: Enbridge completed a US$2.1 billion offering of senior notes due in 2032, 2036 and 2056.
Issued US$700 million of 5.450% senior notes due 2032.
Issued US$800 million of 5.850% senior notes due 2036.
Issued US$600 million of 6.350% senior notes due 2056.
The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Enbridge Energy Partners and Spectra Energy Partners, indirect wholly owned subsidiaries.
